mapper.sql: FROM ( SELECT canonical_symbol FROM stock_daily_bar UNION SELECT canonical_symbol FROM stock_minute_bar ) a LEFT JOIN stock_basic s ON s.canonical_symbol = a.canonical_symbol LEFT JOIN ( SELECT canonical_symbol, COUNT(1) AS bar_count, MIN(trade_date) AS first_bar_date, MAX(trade_date) AS last_bar_date, MAX(fetched_at) AS latest_fetched_at FROM stock_daily_bar GROUP BY canonical_symbol ) d ON d.canonical_symbol = a.canonical_symbol LEFT JOIN ( SELECT canonical_symbol, COUNT(1) AS bar_count, COUNT(DISTINCT interval_type) AS interval_count, MIN(bar_start_time) AS first_bar_time, MAX(bar_start_time) AS last_bar_time, MAX(fetched_at) AS latest_fetched_at FROM stock_minute_bar GROUP BY canonical_symbol ) m ON m.canonical_symbol = a.canonical_symbol

choose.when: AND (s.market IN ('SH', 'SZ', 'BJ') OR a.canonical_symbol LIKE 'SH.%' OR a.canonical_symbol LIKE 'SZ.%' OR a.canonical_symbol LIKE 'BJ.%')

where.if: AND ( UPPER(a.canonical_symbol) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(COALESCE(s.name, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(COALESCE(s.name_cn, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(COALESCE(s.name_hk, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(COALESCE(s.name_en, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') )

mapper.select:
SELECT a.canonical_symbol, s.name, s.name_cn, s.name_hk, s.name_en, s.market, s.currency, COALESCE(d.bar_count, 0) AS daily_bar_count, COALESCE(m.bar_count, 0) AS minute_bar_count, COALESCE(m.interval_count, 0) AS minute_interval_count, d.first_bar_date AS first_daily_date, d.last_bar_date AS last_daily_date, m.first_bar_time AS first_minute_time, m.last_bar_time AS last_minute_time, d.latest_fetched_at AS latest_daily_fetched_at, m.latest_fetched_at AS latest_minute_fetched_at
ORDER BY CASE WHEN d.latest_fetched_at IS NULL THEN m.latest_fetched_at WHEN m.latest_fetched_at IS NULL THEN d.latest_fetched_at WHEN d.latest_fetched_at >= m.latest_fetched_at THEN d.latest_fetched_at ELSE m.latest_fetched_at END DESC, a.canonical_symbol ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
